Glance 2026.09.23 adds command-line control and improves PDF navigation, window sizing, and startup.

- Open previews and control their size, position, pinning, topmost state, and automatic closing with the lightweight `Glance.CLI.exe`. Manage public settings, check for updates, and quit Glance from scripts, with JSON output and documented exit codes. See the [CLI guide](https://github.com/ElluIFX/Glance/blob/v2026.09.23/src/Glance.CLI/README.en.md).
- Preload the previous and next PDF pages for faster navigation, cancelling stale preloads when turning pages quickly.
- Fix adaptive window sizing for Office previews and restore remembered sizes for components excluded from adaptive sizing.
- Reduce repeated UAC prompts by reusing protected scheduled-task authorization for elevated Core startup.
- Reduce release package size by removing unused Windows App SDK files and clean obsolete files during upgrades.
